description: autoloop hooks. Each hook uses the plugin copy and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. Legacy hooks act for the session whose latch names the conversation. Tool guards also protect known scheduler/host entries and state without a latch, and enforce registered worker postures. Viewers do not own a legacy run or its Stop obligations.

hooks.command: payload=$(cat); printf '%s' "$payload" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/loop-execution-admission.mjs" --guard-entry edit; s=$?; [ $s -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $s -eq 2 ] && exit 2; printf '%s' "$payload" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/run-markers.mjs" --tool-guard-fallback; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; l="$HOME/.claude/autoloop/run-latches/$PPID.json"; if [ -e "$l" ] || [ -L "$l" ]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0

payload=$(cat); printf '%s' "$payload" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/loop-execution-admission.mjs" --guard-entry command; s=$?; [ $s -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ $s -eq 2 ] && exit 2; printf '%s' "$payload" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/run-markers.mjs" --tool-guard-fallback; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; l="$HOME/.claude/autoloop/run-latches/$PPID.json"; if [ -e "$l" ] || [ -L "$l" ]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0
